subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Control UI MEMORY.md/bootstrap-file budget meter and save-time enforcement now, and should archive behavior stay separate under the broader bounded-memory design?
rationale: Current main already warns and diagnoses truncation, but refusing workspace-file saves and moving memory content are product and data-lifecycle choices rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Approve a narrow UI guard
options.body: Add Control UI budget display and explicit warning/blocking for bootstrap files, leaving archive and bounded write semantics to separate memory work.

options.title: Fold into bounded memory
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42877 define hard limits and archive behavior first, then implement only the UI affordance that matches that contract.

options.title: Keep diagnostics only
options.body: Declare prompt, /context, and doctor diagnostics sufficient for now and close the save-enforcement/archive direction after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow UI guard
recommendation.body: Add Control UI budget display and explicit warning/blocking for bootstrap files, leaving archive and bounded write semantics to separate memory work.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice spans product defaults, Control UI behavior, and memory lifecycle policy.
